W.note: Tight three-up cards with real size options, sold-out struck-through variants, a stepper and an add label that confirms with Added, plus a bag drawer with totals; the blue accent is a bit standard and the desktop leaves a lot of empty page below.

X.note: Solid filter, search, sort and always-visible bag with shipping and tax, but each card carries a blurb and the mobile layout shows one oversized square image per screen, which is far from compact.

Y.note: Dense five-column desktop grid with a sticky header, but the pastel gradient tiles with initials read as placeholder template decoration, there is no size or variant choice, and add feedback is limited to a tiny badge.

Z.note: Restrained gray glyphs, 44px radio variants with clear sold-out and Notify me states, and a clean stepper and drawer, but the mobile layout collapses to one full-width card per row, wasting most of the screen.
